description:
FILED AND FIXED s473t6d (Opus, 2026-09-20) by #1501 round 11.

`tie $h{foo}, 'C'` / `tie $a[1], 'C'` / `tie $r->{k}, 'C'` / `tie $r->[0], 'C'`
reached `p-tie` with the element's VALUE â a raw string or number, never a
box â so `p-tie` took its announce-and-drop arm
(`PCL: tie: a non-lvalue (class C) is not implemented ...`, task #155's
message) and `tied $h{foo}` read UNDEF.  A tie on a named SCALAR has always
worked, so this was the one-place gap, and the two halves of it were:

  (a) EMISSION.  `tied($h{k})` ALREADY asked for the box
      (`p-gethash-box`), and `pos()` already had the full four-kind table
      (task #960).  `tie`/`untie` had neither.  Three sites, three
      different subsets of one table -- rule 11.

  (b) RUNTIME.  Even with the element promoted, a READ of the element
      returned the proxy itself: `%p-hash-unbox-elem` / `p-aref-unbox-elem`
      read `(p-box-value elem)` and carried the `p-magic-cell-p` arm but not
      the `p-tie-proxy-p` one that `unbox` and `%p-assign-snapshot` already
      have.  Measured before the fix: `print $h{foo}` printed
      `#<p-tie-proxy {1201E4BD33}>` into the program's own output.

FIX
  * `Pl/ExprToCL.pm`: ONE table `%ELEM_BOX_FORM` + `_elem_box_form`, used by
    `pos`, `tied`, `tie` and `untie`.  This also WIDENED `tied` to the two
    deref kinds (`tied($r->{k})`, `tied($r->[0])`), which it had never had.
  * `cl/pcl-runtime.lisp`: a `p-tie-proxy-p` arm in `%p-hash-unbox-elem` and
    `p-aref-unbox-elem`, beside the existing magic-cell arm â the same
    `(unbox (%p-tie-fetch elem v))` the other readers use.

MEASURED
  * `t/op/gmagic.t` **31/2 -> 50/2** (+19 passing rows, 0 new failures) and
    its shortfall **45 -> 26**.
  * corpus emission: ONE file of 111 (`perl-tests/substr.t`, the intended
    `(p-tie (p-gethash %data "a") ...)` -> `(p-tie (p-gethash-box ...) ...)`);
    lib A/B 27 SAME / 0 DIFF / 0 RCDIFF.
  * 10 probe shapes vs perl 5.40.3 identical, including the ones the change
    could break: `tied $h{nokey}` vivifies the key in BOTH (perl does too),
    an untied element still reads its own value and refs, `untie` restores,
    a tied element in list context and interpolation.  The one row that
    still diverges in that probe (`pos($h{k})`) is task #1922, pre-existing.
  * Guard `Pl/t/tie-01.t` 18 -> 24 rows; 5 of the 6 new rows FAIL on a
    `268d7e00` extraction and the 6th (the untied-element control) passes
    there, which is what makes it a control.

RESIDUE, measured and NOT fixed
  * `tie $$s, 'C'` â a tie through a SCALAR-REF DEREFERENCE, where `$s` is
    undef and the tie must AUTOVIVIFY the referent.  `p-cast-$` answers the
    referent's VALUE and there is no box-returning twin, so this is a
    different mechanism (lvalue autovivification of a scalar deref), not a
    fifth row in `%ELEM_BOX_FORM`.  It is what still aborts four top-level
    forms of `t/op/gmagic.t` (its lines 84-121 block) and 23 of the file's
    remaining 26 shortfall rows.
  * `tie $::{gelp}, 'C'` INSTALLS (the emission is the box form) but
    `tied $::{gelp}` answers NO, because a stash read does not hand back the
    same container â `NS:Live symbol-table hashes (%main::, %Foo::)
    [DEFERRED]` / #1664.  2 rows of gmagic.t.
  * A whole-aggregate `tie @a` / `tie %h` is UNCHANGED and still announces
    and drops: task #155, `docs/not-supported.md`.

=== DONE (s473t6d) ===
Shipped with the bars above; ir-spec Â§2.2b rule 6.

COMPANION LEG (member 4, finished s493): besides t/op/gmagic.t 31/2 -> 50/2
this fix moved TWO more companion files, both A/B'd against a `git archive
268d7e00` extraction and spliced -- t/op/tie.t 15/80 -> 17/78 (DATA records 25,
`tie $a->{foo}` with untie() from within FETCH, and 43, RT 5475's `tie $a[0]` /
`tie $h{foo}` FETCH counts) and t/op/inccode.t 13/26 -> 16/25 with its shortfall
50 -> 48 (inccode.t:312 `my $t = tie $INC[0], 'INCtie'` emitted `(p-tie (p-aref
@INC 0) ...)`, the element VALUE, and announced the non-lvalue drop; the form
now stops aborting at "Not a SCALAR reference" and the file reaches 41 rows
instead of 39).
subject: tie/tied/untie on an ELEMENT was DROPPED: the proxy has to go in the element's BOX, and a read of that element has to be a FETCH
